facts.text: Serve the drinks when Bugs fills the water bottle with Michael's secret stuff.
facts.why: Nothing goes into the bottle. At halftime Bugs and Michael pass off plain water as 'Michael's Secret Stuff' to boost the Tune Squad.
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when Bugs hands round the water bottle marked Michael's secret stuff.

facts.text: Carrots for me, a big feed for Michael. He has a game to win and he looks a bit peckish.
facts.why: Not a Bugs line. His real lines on Wikiquote are about the Ducks and being a team. It reads fine as a note in his voice.
facts.fix: Carrots for me, a big feed for Michael. He has a game to win and the Monstars to beat.

fix_note.text: Carrots for me, a big feed for Michael. He has a game to win and the Monstars to beat.

facts.text: Stan from the bench, flattened again.
facts.why: Stan is Jordan's assistant who follows Bugs and Daffy into the Looney Tunes world and joins the team. No source shows him being flattened.
facts.fix: Stan, who followed Bugs and Daffy in.

vibe.verdict: Poster and scoreboard look the part and the secret stuff is there, but the food reads like generic sports food.
